en: Pokémon have lived through a great deal, as I have. I have seen many winters, and they have taught me patience.
I am Pryce, the winter's harsh cold made flesh. Let us see whether you can stand it.
Hmm. Your Pokémon carried you through the cold. You have earned this: the Glacier Badge.
{player} received the Glacier Badge from Pryce!
With it, your Pokémon will use Whirlpool outside of battle, and every Pokémon's Speed rises a little.
Take this as well. It is the winter itself, in a disc.
TM07 is Hail. It brings down a storm of ice that hurts every Pokémon not of the Ice type, for five turns.
When the ice breaks, spring comes. Perhaps you are a spring of sorts for these old bones.
